caption: The drawing features a male figure from the neck to just below the knees, dressed in historical clothing. The figure wears a dark blue frock coat with long sleeves and a high collar, buttoned at the front, and adorned with lace cuffs at the wrists. Underneath, there is a light yellow waistcoat that is also buttoned and has two pockets, paired with knee-length light brown breeches. The shirt underneath has a white ruffled cravat at the neck and lace at the cuffs. The figure is not wearing shoes or stockings, and the head and feet are not included. The background is an off-white or beige color. In the top right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller sketched outline of the coat viewed from the back, rendered only in thin, light lines without color.
title: Man's Suit
